title: Phononic metamaterial lattice for thermal conductivity tuning
abstract: Synthetic abstract. A phononic metamaterial lattice is designed to tune thermal conductivity through phonon band engineering. Simulation of nanoscale silicon shows reduced thermal transport.

title: Nanoscale phonon transport in patterned silicon membranes
abstract: Synthetic abstract. We measure phonon transport in nanoscale patterned silicon membranes and link the thermal conductivity reduction to phononic metamaterial boundary scattering. Simulation supports the measurement.

title: Topology optimization of phononic crystals for heat guiding
abstract: Synthetic abstract. Topology optimization is applied to phononic crystal unit cells to guide heat flow. The simulation framework couples phonon transport with an adjoint solver for thermal design.

title: Thermal rectification in asymmetric phononic metamaterial junctions
abstract: Synthetic abstract. An asymmetric phononic metamaterial junction exhibits thermal rectification. Phonon transport simulation explains the diode-like heat flow at the nanoscale interface.

title: Coherent phonon interference in superlattice thermal metamaterials
abstract: Synthetic abstract. Coherent phonon interference in superlattice thermal metamaterials is shown to lower thermal conductivity. The simulation distinguishes coherent and incoherent phonon transport regimes.

title: Machine learning screening of phononic metamaterial unit cells
abstract: Synthetic abstract. Machine learning screens phononic metamaterial unit cells for target thermal conductivity. A surrogate model accelerates the simulation loop for phonon band design.

title: Topology optimization meets machine learning for thermal metamaterial design
abstract: Synthetic abstract. We combine topology optimization with machine learning to design thermal metamaterial structures. Phonon transport simulation validates the hybrid search over the design space.

title: Experimental demonstration of a phononic thermal cloak
abstract: Synthetic abstract. An experimental phononic thermal cloak is demonstrated using a metamaterial shell. Measured thermal conductivity profiles agree with phonon transport simulation.

title: Bayesian calibration of phonon transport models against thermal measurements
abstract: Synthetic abstract. Bayesian calibration aligns phonon transport simulation with thermal conductivity measurements of nanoscale membranes, quantifying uncertainty in the phonon mean free path spectrum.

title: Graph neural networks for inverse design of thermal metamaterials
abstract: Synthetic abstract. A graph neural network performs inverse design of thermal metamaterial geometries. Machine learning replaces costly phonon transport simulation in the design loop.

title: Active thermal metamaterials with tunable phononic response
abstract: Synthetic abstract. Active thermal metamaterials with electrically tunable phononic response are proposed. Simulation shows switchable thermal conductivity for adaptive heat management.

title: Machine learning discovery of high-rectification phononic junctions
abstract: Synthetic abstract. Machine learning discovers phononic junction geometries with high thermal rectification. Phonon transport simulation confirms the candidates selected by the surrogate model.

title: Multiscale simulation framework for phononic metamaterial devices
abstract: Synthetic abstract. A multiscale simulation framework links atomistic phonon transport to device-scale thermal metamaterial behavior, enabling predictive thermal conductivity design.

title: Topology optimization of active thermal metamaterials under fabrication constraints
abstract: Synthetic abstract. Topology optimization of active thermal metamaterials is extended to fabrication-constrained designs. Machine learning surrogates keep the phonon transport simulation tractable.

title: Open dataset and benchmark for thermal metamaterial inverse design
abstract: Synthetic abstract. An open benchmark dataset for thermal metamaterial inverse design is released, pairing machine learning models with reference phonon transport simulation and thermal conductivity targets.
